father_player_party_greeting_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, there you are! Quite the party we've got going, eh? Your Other Mother has been preparing this for ages. She wouldn't let me tell you a thing!

father_player_party_greeting_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, wonderful! The guest of honor! Welcome to your very own party, kiddo. I must say, the whole house is looking rather splendid!

father_player_party_social_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Your Other Mother certainly knows how to throw a party. She's even got entertainment upstairs and downstairs! Quite extraordinary, really.

father_player_party_social_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: I've been talking to all sorts of wonderful people tonight. Mind you, I seem to have forgotten half their names already. Ha!

father_player_party_entertainment_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Have you been up to the attic yet? I hear Bobinsky's mice have been practicing something rather spectacular. Provided he's here, of course!

father_player_party_entertainment_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Oh, there are some marvelous surprises tucked away around the house tonight. Your Other Mother really has outdone herself.

father_player_party_celebration_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, look at everyone! All gathered here for you, kiddo! Your Other Mother has been keeping this whole thing a surprise. Isn't it wonderful?

father_player_party_celebration_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Well, would you look at that cake! Absolutely magnificent! And so many presents, too. I think you've got quite a bit of unwrapping ahead of you!

father_player_party_finish_1.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Ah, what a wonderful party! Lovely people, marvelous entertainment, and that cake was absolutely delicious. We really ought to do this again!

father_player_party_finish_2.direction: Cheerful, slightly awkward, playful and affectionate.
lines: Well, kiddo, I hope you've enjoyed yourself! It's not every day you get a celebration quite like this one. Your Other Mother certainly knows how to make things special.
